MARINE POLLUTION SUREILLANCE REPORT: UNKNOWN SHEEN IN THE GULF OF MEXICO: MEXICO"S BAY OF CAMPECHE THE LOCATION OF THE SOURCE POINT WAS ESTIMATED FROM SATELLITE IMAGERY. IN THIS BLACK AND WHITE IMAGE, ANOMALY APPEARS DIFFERENT FROM SURROUNDING WATERS AND IS ALIGNED WITH SURFACE WIND FLOW. CONFIDENCE IS REDUCED WITH NO CONFIRMATION OF A SPILL FROM INDEPENDENT SOURCES. THERE DOES APPEAR TO BE SOME ENHANCEMENT DUE TO SUNGLINT CONDITIONS, WHICH ALLOWS FEATURE TO STAND OUT MORE. THE FACT THAT DIMENSIONS AND ORIENTATION CORRELATE WELL WITH LOWER RESOLUTION SATELLITE IMAGE OBSERVED ON THE PREVIOUS DAY (APR-1) DOES BOOST CONFIDENCE. SINCE THE WESTERN EDGE OF THE SATELLITE PASS DOES NOT EXTEND BEYOND WHAT APPEARS TO BE THE WESTERN EXTENT OF THE ANOMALY, IT IS POSSIBLE THAT IT DOES EXTEND A BIT FARTHER THAN WHAT COULD BE ANALYZED.

properties.summary: Incident Type: MOBILE - NRC Report ID: 1308390 - Medium Affected: LAND - Suspected Responsible Party: SEALTEC INDUSTRIES LTD.
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1308390
Incident Time: 2021-06-21 12:00:00
Nearest City: Osoyoos, CN
Location: BLACKTAIL RD AND HWY 3
Incident Type: MOBILE
Material: ASPHALT SEALANT
Medium Affected: LAND
Suspected Responsible Party: SEALTEC INDUSTRIES LTD.
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 49.014984, -119.372388 (Approximated from intersection)
Report DescriptionUPDATE 2/ MOST RECENT DETAILS: RP IS SEALTEC INDUSTRIES LTD. - ESTIMATED QUANTITY REPORTED 20,000L BUT RP ESTIMATES THE TRAILER WAS HALF FULL AT THE TIME OF THE INCIDENT - SEERO KANDIS LIPSETT DISPATCHED TO SCENE - OSOYOOS INDIAN BAND NOTIFIED (MESSAGE LEFT) - RP NOTIFIED, NO KNOWN RESPONSE CONTRACTOR ON RETAINER - RAM ENVIRONMENTAL DISPATCHED BY EERO CALDER GRAHAM UPDATE 1: CALLER ADVISES THE TANKER IS A SINGLE PUP TRAILER THAT HOLDS 21,780 LITRES OF MATERIAL. IT IS STILL UNKNOWN HOW MUCH HAS LEAKED FROM THE TANK OR THE FLOW RATE, BUT IT IS A STEADY FLOW STILL COMING FROM THE TANKER. THE MATERIAL IS ASPHALT SEALANT AND IS LEAKING ONTO CROWN LAND. THERE ARE NO IMMEDIATE WATERWAYS BEING IMPACTED, AND THE CLOSEST WATERWAY IS HAYNES CREEK, WHICH IS A LONG WAYS AWAY. THERE ARE NO FIRST NATIONS IN THE AREA THAT WILL BE IMPACTED AND IT IS CONFIRMED THERE ARE NO INJURIES. ORIGINAL DESCRIPTION: CALLER ADVISES OF A TANKER TRUCK THAT HAS FLIPPED AND SPILLED OIL ALL OVER THE HIGHWAY AND INTO THE DITCH AT THE ABOVE LOCATION. CURRENT INFORMATION STATES THE DRIVER IS OUT OF THE VEHICLE AND IS NOT SUSPECTED TO HAVE ANY INJURIES AND NO MENTION OF FATALITIES. THE TRUCK ITSELF IS THE RIGHT SIDE UP, BUT THE TANKER IS UPSIDE DOWN. IT IS UNCLEAR WHAT KIND OF OIL IS IN THE TANKER, OR HOW MUCH, AND WHAT COMPANY. DISPATCH WILL CALL BACK WITH MORE INFORMATION WHEN AVAILABLE. CREWS ARE WORKING TO CLOSE THE HIGHWAY AT THIS TIME, AND THE WESTBOUND LANE HAS ALREADY BEEN CLOSED, AS THE TANKER IS BLOCKING THE WAY. FIRE AND BCAS ARE ON ROUTE TO THE SCENE, AS WELL AS HIGHWAYS AND FLAGGERS TO ASSIST. THERE HAVE BEEN NO REPORTS OF ANY FIRE OR SMOKE. RCMP FILE NUMBER 21-2711

UPDATE: AT 1019 HOURS, BE TRAIN DISPATCHER, REPORTED 8 CARS DERAILED #14-21, NO HAZMAT INVOLVED. HAZMAT DUTY OFFICER UPDATED. DISPATCHER, BALTIMORE CITY, WAS UPDATED. SUPERVISOR SPECIAL AGENT, REPORTED, SPECIAL AGENT, WAS RESPONDING. LOAD ENGINEERING, WAS NOTIFIED. UPDATE: AT 1140 HOURS, SPECIAL AGENT, REPORTED HE WAS RESPONDING. SPECIAL AGENT, WAS ON SCENE AND REPORTED THIS INCIDENT OCCURRED AT THE CARROL INTERLOCKING AND WOULD BE AFFECTING ALL MAIN LINE OPERATIONS FOR APPROXIMATELY 48 HOURS. THERE WERE 5 CARS REPORTED ON THEIR SIDE AND 2 CARS WERE UP RIGHT AND IN LINE. CAR DAKX 252512 (LOAD, POLYETHYLENE - PELLETS) HAD PRODUCT RELEASE.
